- [3] Share intimacy — Who do you spend time with? How does your relationship evolve?
- [3] Share your heritage — What do you offer of your family's or people's history? What memory or regret does it evoke?
- [3] Stay vigilant — What are you on the lookout for? What do you spot or overhear?
